data.one_liner: Interactive page-flip widget for Flutter with drag, fling, and programmatic control
data.what_it_does: PageFlipBuilder lets you flip between two widgets using drag gestures or code. It supports vertical or horizontal axes, customizable tilt, scale, and duration. The widget works on all platforms and handles unbounded sizes.
use_when: You need a page-turn effect for a book or card UI
You want a full-screen transition between two screens
You need a lightweight, no‑dependency widget for custom animations
avoid_when: You need a complex 3D page-turn with shadows or physics beyond basic tilt
You require a library that integrates with state management or navigation
strengths: Fully null‑safe and up‑to‑date with Dart 3
weaknesses: No built‑in support for multi‑page stacks
No advanced physics or shadow effects
Not a full page‑turn engine like TurnPage
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import package. No special permissions or build_runner needed.
data.minimal_example:
```dart
PageFlipBuilder(
  frontBuilder: (_) => LightHomePage(),
  backBuilder: (_) => DarkHomePage(),
  flipAxis: Axis.horizontal,
  onFlipComplete: (isFront) => print('isFront: $isFront'),
)
```
